title: Synthesis, crystal structures and properties of th
one_line_summary: Design rule: use a mixed-ligand synthetic approach combining tetrazolate with pyridinecarboxylate co-ligands

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] use a mixed-ligand synthetic approach combining tetrazolate with pyridinecarboxylate co-ligands → enables access to unusual MOF architectures

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] functionalize tetrazolate using different substituent functional groups → supports construction of high-dimensional metal-tetrazolate materials

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: Zn-tetrazolate framework with nicotinic acid as second ligand (complex 1) vs Zn-tetrazolate framework with isonicotinic acid as second ligand (complex 2): winner=tie on framework_dimensionality_and_topology

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: Zn-tetrazolate framework with nic ligand replacement of OH group vs similar reported structure from Xiong's group: winner=subject_a on square_grid_Zn-Zn-Zn-Zn_size

key_insights.title: Failure
key_insights.body: [performance_regression] form an interpenetrated MOF structure while aiming to create porosity: porous structure creation is undermined because the cavities are usually occupied by the self-including framework

notable_quotes: Complex 3 is a 3D non-interpenetrated pillared framework based on Cd–COO–Cd double chains and shows a rare (4,6)-connected fsc topology.
The mixed-ligand route using pyridinecarboxylate and in situ generated 5-amino-tetrazolate produced three new MOFs: [Zn(atz)(nic)]n, [Zn(atz)(isonic)]n·nHisonic, and [Cd(atz)(isonic)]n.
The nicotinic vs isonicotinic coordination orientation—bent for nic and straight for isonic—affects crystal structure and properties, giving 1 a 2D net but 2 and 3 3D frameworks.
